verdict.diagnostic_adequacy: bounded_localization_evidence_added; native cause and recovery remain unverified
verdict.quality_doctrine: sound privacy projection, independent measurements, and cleanup ordering; narrow stage-guard gap

evidence.measurements: native CDP window state, Chrome root/window focus and side-panel context association, and Scrape control center hit/geometry are separate; unavailable boundaries stay measured=false
evidence.privacy: tab/window/context IDs, URLs, titles, page content, and transport error text are not projected; no authenticated screenshots added
evidence.worker_lifecycle: observes through the attached original panel target and Chrome APIs; no cached MV3 worker target needed
evidence.cleanup: web close then root activation remain ordered even if optional observations fail; auth failure remains the surfaced failure
evidence.observed_failure: run 37248327805 first recorded hidden visibility after authentication; current observations can distinguish later boundaries but do not prove which transition caused it

limitations: The native/host/hit evidence remains synthetic-test verified; no new browser run was performed or requested.
Tests assert close/activation checkpoints and host observer behavior, but do not independently assert member_web_created and member_oauth_completed callback coverage against mutations.
The diagnostic labels a host API failure unmeasured; it intentionally does not interpret missing measurement as a cause.
recommendation: Accept this as an evidence-instrumentation improvement, not as a diagnosis or recovery fix. Keep the next frozen native run as the causal discriminator; optionally add mutations for the page-created and OAuth-return callback stages before relying on these guards as complete stage coverage.
